<pasted_content id="6efa">
Summary
Use the helper and label from #125 on the five remaining widget reports: Formula, Sankey, Budget Analysis, Balance Forecast and Monte Carlo. The last four are experimental and only appear when their feature flag is on in Settings → Experimental features.

User Story
As a user building Formula widgets or trying the experimental reports, I want to see a "(modified)" label when my changes aren't saved so that I don't lose settings that took effort to set up, such as formulas or simulation inputs.

User Scenario
A user turns on the Monte Carlo experimental feature and opens a Monte Carlo widget. They change the simulation inputs, and "(modified)" appears next to the widget name. They press Save widget, and the label disappears.

Acceptance Criteria
Given any of the five reports opened from a widget, when the user changes a setting that Save widget would save, then "(modified)" appears next to the widget name. Saving successfully, or changing the setting back, removes it.
Given a Formula widget, when the user edits the formula text without saving, then the label appears.
Given Balance Forecast or Monte Carlo, which write to the saved widget from more than one place in their code, when one of those other saves happens, then the label reflects the newly saved settings and is not stuck on "(modified)". A unit test covers this.
Given a report whose feature flag is off, then nothing about the app's behavior changes.
Out of Scope
The reports covered by Show a "(modified)" label on the standard report widgets #125.
Taking any report out of experimental status.
Any dialog or prompt when leaving the page.
Open Questions
Monte Carlo computes results that may be stored with the widget. Should computed values be left out of the comparison, so only the user's inputs count as changes? (Proposed: yes.)
Scope
Medium: only five reports and the pattern already exists from #125, but Formula, Balance Forecast and Monte Carlo store more complicated settings than the reports in #125, and each experimental report needs its feature flag turned on to test.

Source
Split out of #96.

Design
Owner: record at least one non-trivial decision, with at least two alternatives, the rationale and the consequences. For example, how to keep the label correct when a report saves to its widget from more than one place.
</pasted_content id="6efa">

import * as monthUtils from '@actual-app/core/shared/months';
import type {
  RuleConditionEntity,
  TimeFrame,
} from '@actual-app/core/types/models';
import { isEqual } from 'es-toolkit';

/**
 * A time frame reduced to the setting the user chose, not the dates it
 * currently resolves to. Relative ranges (for example a sliding window or
 * "year to date") are re-resolved every time a report opens, so comparing
 * their dates would flag a widget as modified just because time has passed.
 */
export type ComparableTimeFrame =
  | { mode: 'static'; start: string; end: string }
  | { mode: 'sliding-window'; shape: 'day' | 'month'; width: number }
  | { mode: Exclude<TimeFrame['mode'], 'static' | 'sliding-window'> };

export function toComparableTimeFrame(
  timeFrame?: Partial<TimeFrame> | null,
  defaultTimeFrame?: Partial<TimeFrame>,
): ComparableTimeFrame {
  // Mirrors the fallbacks in `calculateTimeRange` so a widget without a
  // saved time frame compares equal to the range the report opens with.
  const start =
    timeFrame?.start ??
    defaultTimeFrame?.start ??
    monthUtils.subMonths(monthUtils.currentMonth(), 5);
  const end =
    timeFrame?.end ?? defaultTimeFrame?.end ?? monthUtils.currentMonth();
  const mode = timeFrame?.mode ?? defaultTimeFrame?.mode ?? 'sliding-window';

  if (mode === 'static') {
    return { mode, start, end };
  }

  if (mode === 'sliding-window') {
    if (
      monthUtils.isValidYearMonthDay(start) &&
      monthUtils.isValidYearMonthDay(end)
    ) {
      return {
        mode,
        shape: 'day',
        width: Math.max(monthUtils.differenceInCalendarDays(end, start), 0),
      };
    }
    return {
      mode,
      shape: 'month',
      width: monthUtils.differenceInCalendarMonths(end, start),
    };
  }

  return { mode };
}

export type ComparableConditions = {
  conditions: RuleConditionEntity[];
  conditionsOp: 'and' | 'or';
};

export function toComparableConditions(
  conditions?: RuleConditionEntity[] | null,
  conditionsOp?: 'and' | 'or' | null,
): ComparableConditions {
  // Same defaults as `useRuleConditionFilters`.
  return {
    conditions: conditions ?? [],
    conditionsOp: conditionsOp ?? 'and',
  };
}

// Drops keys whose value is `undefined`, the same way saving the widget
// does, so `{ a: undefined }` and `{}` compare equal.
function toSavedShape(value: unknown): unknown {
  return value === undefined ? undefined : JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(value));
}

type IsWidgetModifiedArgs<T> = {
  /** False when the report was opened without a widget. */
  hasWidget: boolean;
  /** False until the report has finished loading its saved settings. */
  isReady: boolean;
  /** The saved widget settings, in comparable form. */
  saved: T;
  /** The settings "Save widget" would write now, in comparable form. */
  current: T;
};

export function isWidgetModified<T>({
  hasWidget,
  isReady,
  saved,
  current,
}: IsWidgetModifiedArgs<T>): boolean {
  if (!hasWidget || !isReady) {
    return false;
  }
  return !isEqual(toSavedShape(saved), toSavedShape(current));
}

export function ReportWidgetTitle({
  title,
  onSave,
  isModified,
}: ReportWidgetTitleProps) {
  return (
    <View style={{ flexDirection: 'row', alignItems: 'center', gap: 8 }}>
      {onSave ? (
        <EditablePageHeaderTitle title={title} onSave={onSave} />
      ) : (
        title
      )}
      {isModified && (
        <ModifiedLabel
          style={{ fontWeight: 400, color: theme.pageTextSubdued }}
        />
      )}
    </View>
  );
}

import type {
  NetWorthWidget,
  RuleConditionEntity,
  TimeFrame,
} from '@actual-app/core/types/models';

import {
  toComparableConditions,
  toComparableTimeFrame,
} from '#components/reports/widgetModified';

type NetWorthMeta = NonNullable<NetWorthWidget['meta']>;
type NetWorthInterval = NonNullable<NetWorthMeta['interval']>;
type NetWorthGraphMode = NonNullable<NetWorthMeta['mode']>;

export type NetWorthWidgetSettings = Required<
  Pick<
    NetWorthMeta,
    'conditions' | 'conditionsOp' | 'interval' | 'mode' | 'timeFrame'
  >
>;

export function getDefaultNetWorthInterval(
  mode: TimeFrame['mode'],
): NetWorthInterval {
  // A single month reads better week by week than as one monthly point.
  return mode === 'lastMonth' ? 'Weekly' : 'Monthly';
}

/** The settings "Save widget" writes for a Net Worth widget. */
export function buildNetWorthWidgetSettings({
  conditions,
  conditionsOp,
  interval,
  graphMode,
  start,
  end,
  mode,
}: {
  conditions: RuleConditionEntity[];
  conditionsOp: 'and' | 'or';
  interval: NetWorthInterval;
  graphMode: NetWorthGraphMode;
  start: string;
  end: string;
  mode: TimeFrame['mode'];
}): NetWorthWidgetSettings {
  return {
    conditions,
    conditionsOp,
    interval,
    mode: graphMode,
    timeFrame: { start, end, mode },
  };
}

export function toComparableNetWorthSettings(
  meta: Partial<NetWorthMeta> | null | undefined,
) {
  const timeFrame = toComparableTimeFrame(meta?.timeFrame);
  return {
    ...toComparableConditions(meta?.conditions, meta?.conditionsOp),
    interval: meta?.interval ?? getDefaultNetWorthInterval(timeFrame.mode),
    mode: meta?.mode ?? 'trend',
    timeFrame,
  };
}
import * as monthUtils from '@actual-app/core/shared/months';
import type {
  AccountEntity,
  CategoryEntity,
  CrossoverWidget,
  TimeFrame,
} from '@actual-app/core/types/models';

import { calculateTimeRange } from '#components/reports/reportRanges';
import { toComparableTimeFrame } from '#components/reports/widgetModified';

type CrossoverMeta = NonNullable<CrossoverWidget['meta']>;

export const defaultTimeFrame = {
  start: monthUtils.subMonths(monthUtils.currentMonth(), 120),
  end: monthUtils.subMonths(monthUtils.currentMonth(), 1),
  mode: 'full',
} satisfies TimeFrame;

/**
 * Fits a range to the months the report can show. The current month is never
 * included, so sliding windows end last month and "all time" spans every
 * month with data.
 */
export function adjustCrossoverRange(
  start: string,
  end: string,
  mode: TimeFrame['mode'],
  earliestMonth: string,
  latestMonth: string,
): [string, string] {
  const clampMonth = (month: string) => {
    if (monthUtils.isBefore(month, earliestMonth)) return earliestMonth;
    if (monthUtils.isAfter(month, latestMonth)) return latestMonth;
    return month;
  };

  let adjustedStart: string;
  let adjustedEnd: string;
  if (mode === 'sliding-window') {
    adjustedStart = clampMonth(monthUtils.subMonths(start, 1));
    adjustedEnd = clampMonth(monthUtils.subMonths(end, 1));
  } else if (mode === 'full') {
    adjustedStart = earliestMonth;
    adjustedEnd = latestMonth;
  } else {
    adjustedStart = clampMonth(start);
    adjustedEnd = clampMonth(end);
  }
  if (monthUtils.isBefore(adjustedEnd, adjustedStart)) {
    adjustedEnd = adjustedStart;
  }
  return [adjustedStart, adjustedEnd];
}

export type CrossoverRangeContext = {
  earliestMonth: string;
  latestMonth: string;
  latestTransaction: string;
};

/** The range the report shows for a saved time frame. */
export function resolveCrossoverTimeFrame(
  timeFrame: Partial<TimeFrame> | undefined,
  { earliestMonth, latestMonth, latestTransaction }: CrossoverRangeContext,
): TimeFrame {
  const [start, end, mode] = calculateTimeRange(
    timeFrame,
    defaultTimeFrame,
    latestTransaction,
  );
  const [adjustedStart, adjustedEnd] = adjustCrossoverRange(
    start,
    end,
    mode,
    earliestMonth,
    latestMonth,
  );
  return { start: adjustedStart, end: adjustedEnd, mode };
}

export type CrossoverWidgetSettings = Required<
  Pick<
    CrossoverMeta,
    | 'expenseCategoryIds'
    | 'incomeAccountIds'
    | 'safeWithdrawalRate'
    | 'estimatedReturn'
    | 'expectedContribution'
    | 'projectionType'
    | 'expenseAdjustmentFactor'
    | 'showHiddenCategories'
    | 'timeFrame'
  >
>;

/** The settings "Save widget" writes for a Crossover Point widget. */
export function buildCrossoverWidgetSettings({
  selectedExpenseCategories,
  selectedIncomeAccountIds,
  swr,
  useCustomGrowth,
  estimatedReturn,
  expectedContribution,
  projectionType,
  expenseAdjustmentFactor,
  showHiddenCategories,
  start,
  end,
  mode,
}: {
  selectedExpenseCategories: Array<Pick<CategoryEntity, 'id'>>;
  selectedIncomeAccountIds: string[];
  swr: number;
  useCustomGrowth: boolean;
  estimatedReturn: number | null;
  expectedContribution: number | null;
  projectionType: 'hampel' | 'median' | 'mean';
  expenseAdjustmentFactor: number;
  showHiddenCategories: boolean;
  start: string;
  end: string;
  mode: TimeFrame['mode'];
}): CrossoverWidgetSettings {
  return {
    expenseCategoryIds: selectedExpenseCategories.map(c => c.id),
    incomeAccountIds: selectedIncomeAccountIds,
    safeWithdrawalRate: swr,
    estimatedReturn: useCustomGrowth ? (estimatedReturn ?? 0) : null,
    expectedContribution: useCustomGrowth ? (expectedContribution ?? 0) : null,
    projectionType,
    expenseAdjustmentFactor,
    showHiddenCategories,
    timeFrame: { start, end, mode },
  };
}

export type CrossoverComparisonContext = {
  categories: Array<Pick<CategoryEntity, 'id' | 'is_income'>>;
  accounts: Array<Pick<AccountEntity, 'id'>>;
  /** Missing until the months with data have loaded. */
  range?: CrossoverRangeContext;
};

export function toComparableCrossoverSettings(
  meta: Partial<CrossoverMeta> | null | undefined,
  { categories, accounts, range }: CrossoverComparisonContext,
) {
  // Mirrors how the report reads the saved selections: no saved list means
  // everything, and categories that no longer exist are dropped. Reading
  // through the category list also puts both sides in the same order.
  const savedCategoryIds = meta?.expenseCategoryIds;
  const expenseCategoryIds =
    savedCategoryIds !== undefined
      ? categories.filter(c => savedCategoryIds.includes(c.id)).map(c => c.id)
      : categories.filter(c => !c.is_income).map(c => c.id);
  const incomeAccountIds = meta?.incomeAccountIds ?? accounts.map(a => a.id);

  return {
    expenseCategoryIds,
    incomeAccountIds: [...incomeAccountIds].sort(),
    safeWithdrawalRate: meta?.safeWithdrawalRate ?? 0.04,
    estimatedReturn: meta?.estimatedReturn ?? null,
    expectedContribution: meta?.expectedContribution ?? null,
    projectionType: meta?.projectionType ?? 'hampel',
    expenseAdjustmentFactor: meta?.expenseAdjustmentFactor ?? 1.0,
    showHiddenCategories: meta?.showHiddenCategories ?? false,
    timeFrame: toComparableTimeFrame(
      range
        ? resolveCrossoverTimeFrame(meta?.timeFrame, range)
        : meta?.timeFrame,
      defaultTimeFrame,
    ),
  };
}

19	import { MobileBackButton } from '#components/mobile/MobileBackButton';
20	import { MobilePageHeader, Page, PageHeader } from '#components/Page';
21	import { PrivacyFilter } from '#components/PrivacyFilter';
22	import { MonteCarloCashflowGraph } from '#components/reports/graphs/MonteCarloCashflowGraph';
23	import { MonteCarloGraph } from '#components/reports/graphs/MonteCarloGraph';
24	import type { MonteCarloGraphView } from '#components/reports/graphs/MonteCarloGraphTooltip';
25	import { MonteCarloHistogram } from '#components/reports/graphs/MonteCarloHistogram';
26	import { LoadingIndicator } from '#components/reports/LoadingIndicator';
27	import { MonteCarloConfiguration } from '#components/reports/reports/monte-carlo/MonteCarloConfiguration';
28	import { HISTORICAL_ANNUAL_RETURNS } from '#components/reports/reports/monte-carlo/monteCarloHistoricalReturns';
29	import { MonteCarloRunDetailTable } from '#components/reports/reports/monte-carlo/MonteCarloRunDetailTable';
30	import {
31	  getRunPercentileOptions,
32	  MonteCarloRunsTable,
33	} from '#components/reports/reports/monte-carlo/MonteCarloRunsTable';
34	import {
35	  getMonteCarloHorizonYears,
36	  MONTE_CARLO_DEFAULTS,
37	  monteCarloConfigFromMeta,
38	  rankSimulationsWorstFirst,
39	  runMonteCarloSimulation,
40	} from '#components/reports/reports/monte-carlo/monteCarloSimulation';
41	import type { MonteCarloConfig } from '#components/reports/reports/monte-carlo/monteCarloSimulation';
42	import { GROUP_HEADING_STYLE } from '#components/reports/reports/monte-carlo/monteCarloStyles';
43	import { useResolvedMonteCarloConfig } from '#components/reports/reports/monte-carlo/useResolvedMonteCarloConfig';
44	import { useDashboardWidget } from '#hooks/useDashboardWidget';
45	import { useFormat } from '#hooks/useFormat';
46	import { useNavigate } from '#hooks/useNavigate';
47	import { addNotification } from '#notifications/notificationsSlice';
48	import { useDispatch } from '#redux';
49	import { useUpdateDashboardWidgetMutation } from '#reports/mutations';
50	
51	const firstYear = HISTORICAL_ANNUAL_RETURNS[0].year;
52	const lastYear =
53	  HISTORICAL_ANNUAL_RETURNS[HISTORICAL_ANNUAL_RETURNS.length - 1].year;
54	
55	export function MonteCarlo() {
56	  const params = useParams();
57	  const { data: widget, isLoading } = useDashboardWidget<MonteCarloWidget>({
58	    id: params.id,
59	    type: 'monte-carlo-card',
60	  });
61	
62	  const { t } = useTranslation();
63	  const dispatch = useDispatch();
64	  const format = useFormat();
65	  const navigate = useNavigate();
66	  const { isNarrowWidth } = useResponsive();
67	
68	  const [config, setConfig] = useState<MonteCarloConfig>(MONTE_CARLO_DEFAULTS);
69	  const [graphView, setGraphView] = useState<MonteCarloGraphView>('all');
70	  const [resultsView, setResultsView] = useState<'chart' | 'cashflow' | 'runs'>(
71	    'chart',
72	  );
73	  // Which run the cashflow view charts, as a percentile of the worst-first
74	  // ranking (0 = worst run, 1 = best run) - the runs table's Jump to
75	  // percentiles, so both land on the same runs
76	  const [cashflowPercentile, setCashflowPercentile] = useState(0.5);
77	  const [showTodaysMoney, setShowTodaysMoney] = useState(true);
78	  // A selected run refers to a specific simulation, so the selection is
79	  // stored with the config it belongs to and silently expires when the
80	  // config changes - no effect, no wasted render with a stale selection
81	  const [selectedRun, setSelectedRun] = useState<{
82	    forConfig: MonteCarloConfig;
83	    index: number;
84	  } | null>(null);
85	  const [selectionsInitialized, setSelectionsInitialized] = useState(false);
86	
87	  const selectedRunIndex =
88	    selectedRun != null && selectedRun.forConfig === config
89	      ? selectedRun.index
90	      : null;
91	
92	  const resolvedConfig = useResolvedMonteCarloConfig(config);
93	
94	  // reset when widget changes
95	  useEffect(() => {
96	    setSelectionsInitialized(false);
97	  }, [widget?.id]);
98	
99	  // initialize once when the widget (if any) is available
100	  useEffect(() => {
101	    if (selectionsInitialized || isLoading) {
102	      return;
103	    }
104	
105	    setConfig(monteCarloConfigFromMeta(widget?.meta));
106	    setSelectionsInitialized(true);
107	  }, [selectionsInitialized, isLoading, widget?.meta]);
108	
109	  // Only the stable `mutate` is kept: the mutation result is a new object
110	  // every render, and closing over it would defeat memoisation below
111	  const { mutate: updateWidget } = useUpdateDashboardWidgetMutation();
112	
113	  async function onSaveWidget() {
114	    // The save button only renders when a widget exists
115	    if (!widget) {
116	      return;
117	    }
118	
119	    updateWidget(
120	      {
121	        widget: {
122	          id: widget.id,
123	          meta: {
124	            ...(widget.meta ?? {}),
125	            // Persist the resolved config so linked pots' stored balances
126	            // stay fresh as a fallback while live balances load
127	            ...resolvedConfig,
128	          },
129	        },
130	      },
131	      {
132	        onSuccess: () => {
133	          dispatch(
134	            addNotification({
135	              notification: {
136	                type: 'message',
137	                message: t('Dashboard widget successfully saved.'),
138	              },
139	            }),
140	          );
141	        },
142	      },
143	    );
144	  }
145	
146	  const title = widget?.meta?.name || t('Monte Carlo Analysis');
147	  const onSaveWidgetName = async (newName: string) => {
148	    // The editable title only renders when a widget exists
149	    if (!widget) {
150	      return;
151	    }
152	
153	    const name = newName || t('Monte Carlo Analysis');
154	    updateWidget({
155	      widget: {
156	        id: widget.id,
157	        meta: {
158	          ...(widget.meta ?? {}),
159	          name,
160	        },
161	      },
162	    });
163	  };
164	
165	  // The simulation is the expensive part of this page (thousands of
166	  // runs on the main thread), so it is memoised by hand on its actual
167	  // inputs: view switches, run selection and other UI state must not
168	  // re-run it. Nothing runs until the saved config has been loaded
169	  const simulation = useMemo(() => {
170	    if (!selectionsInitialized) {
171	      return null;
172	    }
173	    const params = {
174	      ...resolvedConfig,
175	      horizonYears: getMonteCarloHorizonYears(resolvedConfig),
176	      deflateToTodaysMoney: showTodaysMoney,
177	    };
178	    return { params, result: runMonteCarloSimulation(params) };
179	  }, [resolvedConfig, showTodaysMoney, selectionsInitialized]);
180	
181	  // The worst-first ranking shared by the runs table and the cashflow
182	  // view's percentile picker, sorted once per simulation
183	  const rankedRunIndices = useMemo(
184	    () =>
185	      simulation == null
186	        ? null
187	        : rankSimulationsWorstFirst(
188	            simulation.result.endingBalances,
189	            simulation.result.depletionYearBySimulation,
190	          ),
191	    [simulation],
192	  );
193	
194	  // The cashflow view charts one run picked by percentile of the ranking
195	  const cashflowRunIndex =
196	    resultsView === 'cashflow' && simulation != null && rankedRunIndices != null
197	      ? rankedRunIndices[
198	          Math.round(
199	            cashflowPercentile * (simulation.result.simulationCount - 1),
200	          )
201	        ]
202	      : null;
203	
204	  // The run whose year-by-year detail is on screen: the cashflow view's
205	  // scenario, or the drill-in's selection from the runs table
206	  const detailRunIndex =
207	    resultsView === 'cashflow' ? cashflowRunIndex : selectedRunIndex;
208	
209	  // Runs are seeded, so re-running with a capture index reproduces the
210	  // selected run exactly; only computed while a run is being inspected,
211	  // and once per run rather than on every render
212	  const runDetailRows = useMemo(
213	    () =>
214	      simulation == null || detailRunIndex == null
215	        ? null
216	        : runMonteCarloSimulation({
217	            ...simulation.params,
218	            captureRunDetail: detailRunIndex,
219	          }).runDetail,
220	    [simulation, detailRunIndex],
221	  );
222	
223	  if (
224	    isLoading ||
225	    !selectionsInitialized ||
226	    simulation == null ||
227	    rankedRunIndices == null
228	  ) {
229	    return <LoadingIndicator />;
230	  }
231	
232	  const { result } = simulation;
233	  // After a failure the capture continues with synthetic unfunded years
234	  // for the cashflow chart; the year-by-year table ends at the failure
235	  const fundedRunDetailRows =
236	    runDetailRows?.filter(row => !row.afterDepletion) ?? null;
237	  const cashflowGraphProps = {
238	    pots: resolvedConfig.pots,
239	    contributions: resolvedConfig.contributions,
240	    incomeStreams: resolvedConfig.incomeStreams,
241	    spendingPhases: resolvedConfig.spendingPhases,
242	    startAge: config.currentAge,
243	  };
244	
245	  // The age the simulation actually runs to (differs from targetAge only
246	  // when the configured ages produce a clamped horizon)
247	  const endAge = config.currentAge + result.horizonYears;
248	  const successPercent = Math.round(result.successRate * 1000) / 10;
249	  const depletionPercent = Math.round((1 - result.successRate) * 1000) / 10;
250	  const failedCount = result.depletionHistogram.reduce(
251	    (sum, entry) => sum + entry.count,
252	    0,
253	  );
254	  const hasFailures = failedCount > 0;
255	  const successColor =
256	    result.successRate >= 0.75
257	      ? theme.reportsNumberPositive
258	      : result.successRate >= 0.5
259	        ? theme.warningText
260	        : theme.reportsNumberNegative;
261	
262	  return (
263	    <Page
264	      header={
265	        isNarrowWidth ? (
266	          <MobilePageHeader
267	            title={title}
268	            leftContent={
269	              <MobileBackButton onPress={() => navigate('/reports')} />
270	            }
271	          />
272	        ) : (
273	          <PageHeader
274	            title={
275	              widget ? (
276	                <EditablePageHeaderTitle
277	                  title={title}
278	                  onSave={onSaveWidgetName}
279	                />
280	              ) : (
281	                title
282	              )
283	            }
284	          />
285	        )
286	      }
287	      padding={0}
288	    >
289	      <View
290	        style={{
291	          flex: 1,
292	          overflowY: 'auto',
293	          paddingLeft: !isNarrowWidth ? 20 : 10,
294	          paddingRight: !isNarrowWidth ? 20 : 10,
295	          paddingBottom: 20,
296	          gap: 10,
297	        }}
298	      >
299	        {/* Configuration */}
300	        <View style={{ flexShrink: 0 }}>
301	          <View
302	            style={{
303	              flexDirection: 'row',
304	              alignItems: 'center',
305	              justifyContent: 'space-between',
306	              padding: '10px 0',
307	              flexShrink: 0,
308	            }}
309	          >
310	            <Text
311	              style={{
312	                ...styles.mediumText,
313	                fontWeight: 600,
314	              }}
315	            >
316	              <Trans>Configuration</Trans>
317	            </Text>
318	            {widget && (
319	              <Button variant="primary" onPress={onSaveWidget}>
320	                <Trans>Save widget</Trans>
321	              </Button>
322	            )}
323	          </View>
324	          <MonteCarloConfiguration
325	            config={resolvedConfig}
326	            onConfigChange={changes =>
327	              setConfig(prev => ({ ...prev, ...changes }))
328	            }
329	          />
330	        </View>
331	
332	        {/* Results */}
333	        <View
334	          style={{
335	            flexDirection: 'row',
336	            alignItems: 'center',
337	            justifyContent: 'space-between',
338	            flexWrap: 'wrap',
339	            gap: 10,
340	            padding: '10px 0',
341	            flexShrink: 0,
342	          }}
343	        >
344	          <Text
345	            style={{
346	              ...styles.mediumText,
347	              fontWeight: 600,
348	            }}
349	          >
350	            <Trans>Results</Trans>
351	          </Text>
352	          <LabeledCheckbox
353	            id="mc-todays-money"
354	            checked={showTodaysMoney}
355	            onChange={event => setShowTodaysMoney(event.target.checked)}
356	            style={{ flex: 'unset' }}
357	          >
358	            <Trans>Show values in today&apos;s money</Trans>
359	          </LabeledCheckbox>
360	        </View>
361	
362	        {/* Headline stats */}
363	        <View
364	          style={{
365	            backgroundColor: theme.tableBackground,
366	            padding: 20,
367	            flexShrink: 0,
368	            gap: 15,
369	          }}
370	        >
371	          <View
372	            style={{
373	              flexDirection: 'row',
374	              flexWrap: 'wrap',
375	              gap: 40,
376	              rowGap: 20,
377	              alignItems: 'flex-start',
378	            }}
379	          >
380	            <View style={{ gap: 4 }}>
381	              <Text style={GROUP_HEADING_STYLE}>
382	                <Trans>Success rate</Trans>
383	              </Text>
384	              <Text
385	                style={{
386	                  ...styles.veryLargeText,
387	                  color: successColor,
388	                }}
389	              >
390	                <FinancialText as="span">{`${successPercent}%`}</FinancialText>
391	              </Text>
392	            </View>
393	            <View style={{ gap: 4 }}>
394	              <Text style={GROUP_HEADING_STYLE}>
395	                <Trans>Median ending balance</Trans>
396	              </Text>
397	              <Text style={{ ...styles.mediumText, fontWeight: 500 }}>
398	                <PrivacyFilter>
399	                  <FinancialText as="span">
400	                    {format(result.medianEndingBalance, 'financial')}
401	                  </FinancialText>
402	                </PrivacyFilter>
403	              </Text>
404	            </View>
405	            <View style={{ gap: 4 }}>
406	              <Text style={GROUP_HEADING_STYLE}>
407	                <Trans>Median total withdrawn</Trans>
408	              </Text>
409	              <Text style={{ ...styles.mediumText, fontWeight: 500 }}>
410	                <PrivacyFilter>
411	                  <FinancialText as="span">
412	                    {format(result.medianTotalWithdrawn, 'financial')}
413	                  </FinancialText>
414	                </PrivacyFilter>
415	              </Text>
416	            </View>
417	            <View style={{ gap: 4 }}>
418	              <Text style={GROUP_HEADING_STYLE}>
419	                <Trans>Chance of running out of money</Trans>
420	              </Text>
421	              <Text style={{ ...styles.mediumText, fontWeight: 500 }}>
422	                <FinancialText as="span">{`${depletionPercent}%`}</FinancialText>
423	              </Text>
424	            </View>
425	            {result.medianDepletionYear != null && (
426	              <View style={{ gap: 4 }}>
427	                <Text style={GROUP_HEADING_STYLE}>
428	                  <Trans>Typical failure runs out at</Trans>
429	                </Text>
430	                <Text style={{ ...styles.mediumText, fontWeight: 500 }}>
431	                  {t('Age {{age}}', {
432	                    // Ages here are the failure year itself, matching the
433	                    // drill-in's failure row
434	                    age: config.currentAge + result.medianDepletionYear - 1,
435	                  })}
436	                </Text>
437	              </View>
438	            )}
439	          </View>
440	          <View style={{ marginTop: 10, gap: 5 }}>
441	            <Text style={GROUP_HEADING_STYLE}>
442	              <Trans>Summary</Trans>
443	            </Text>
444	            <Text>
445	              {t(
446	                'In {{successPercent}}% of {{simulationCount}} simulated scenarios, your pot lasted until age {{endAge}}.',
447	                {
448	                  successPercent,
449	                  simulationCount: result.simulationCount,
450	                  endAge,
451	                },
452	              )}
453	            </Text>
454	          </View>
455	        </View>
456	
457	        {/* Portfolio performance chart / simulation runs table */}
458	        <View
459	          style={{
460	            backgroundColor: theme.tableBackground,
461	            padding: 20,
462	            paddingBottom: resultsView === 'chart' ? 10 : 20,
463	            ...(resultsView === 'chart' && { height: 470 }),
464	            flexShrink: 0,
465	          }}
466	        >
467	          <View
468	            style={{
469	              flexDirection: 'row',
470	              alignItems: 'center',
471	              justifyContent: 'space-between',
472	              flexWrap: 'wrap',
473	              gap: 10,
474	              marginBottom: 10,
475	              flexShrink: 0,
476	            }}
477	          >
478	            <View
479	              style={{ flexDirection: 'row', alignItems: 'center', gap: 15 }}
480	            >
481	              <Text style={{ ...styles.mediumText, fontWeight: 600 }}>
482	                {resultsView === 'chart' ? (
483	                  <Trans>Portfolio performance</Trans>
484	                ) : resultsView === 'cashflow' ? (
485	                  <Trans>Cashflow</Trans>
486	                ) : (
487	                  <Trans>Simulation runs</Trans>
488	                )}
489	              </Text>
490	              <View style={{ flexDirection: 'row', gap: 5 }}>
491	                <ModeButton
492	                  selected={resultsView === 'chart'}
493	                  onSelect={() => setResultsView('chart')}
494	                >
495	                  <Trans>Chart</Trans>
496	                </ModeButton>
497	                <ModeButton
498	                  selected={resultsView === 'cashflow'}
499	                  onSelect={() => setResultsView('cashflow')}
500	                >
501	                  <Trans>Cashflow</Trans>
502	                </ModeButton>
503	                <ModeButton
504	                  selected={resultsView === 'runs'}
505	                  onSelect={() => setResultsView('runs')}
506	                >
507	                  <Trans>Runs</Trans>
508	                </ModeButton>
509	              </View>
510	            </View>
511	            {resultsView === 'chart' && (
512	              <Select
513	                value={graphView}
514	                onChange={value => setGraphView(value as MonteCarloGraphView)}
515	                options={[
516	                  ['all', t('All scenarios')],
517	                  ['single-worst', t('Single worst run')],
518	                  ['worst-case', t('Worst-case scenario (5th percentile)')],
519	                  ['pessimistic', t('Pessimistic scenario (30th percentile)')],
520	                  ['median', t('Median scenario (50th percentile)')],
521	                  ['optimistic', t('Optimistic scenario (70th percentile)')],
522	                ]}
523	                style={{ width: 280 }}
524	              />
525	            )}
526	            {resultsView === 'cashflow' && (
527	              <Select
528	                value={String(cashflowPercentile)}
529	                onChange={value => setCashflowPercentile(Number(value))}
530	                options={getRunPercentileOptions(t)}
531	                style={{ width: 200 }}
532	              />
533	            )}
534	          </View>
535	          {resultsView === 'chart' ? (
536	            <>
537	              {graphView !== 'all' && (
538	                <Text
539	                  style={{
540	                    color: theme.pageText,
541	                    marginBottom: 10,
542	                    flexShrink: 0,
543	                  }}
544	                >
545	                  {graphView === 'single-worst'
546	                    ? t(
547	                        'The unluckiest of all {{simulationCount}} simulated runs - the one that ran out of money earliest.',
548	                        { simulationCount: result.simulationCount },
549	                      )
550	                    : graphView === 'worst-case'
551	                      ? t('95% of scenarios stayed above this line.')
552	                      : graphView === 'pessimistic'
553	                        ? t('70% of scenarios stayed above this line.')
554	                        : graphView === 'median'
555	                          ? t('Half of scenarios stayed above this line.')
556	                          : t('30% of scenarios stayed above this line.')}
557	                </Text>
558	              )}
559	              <MonteCarloGraph
560	                percentileBands={result.percentileBands}
561	                startAge={config.currentAge}
562	                worstRunPath={result.worstRunPath}
563	                view={graphView}
564	                style={{ height: '100%', flex: 1 }}
565	              />
566	            </>
567	          ) : resultsView === 'cashflow' ? (
568	            runDetailRows != null && (
569	              <>
570	                <Text
571	                  style={{
572	                    color: theme.pageText,
573	                    marginBottom: 10,
574	                    flexShrink: 0,
575	                  }}
576	                >
577	                  <Trans>
578	                    Money flowing in and out each year of this simulated run:
579	                    withdrawals and income above zero; planned spending, tax,
580	                    contributions and money saved into the surplus pot below.
581	                  </Trans>
582	                </Text>
583	                <MonteCarloCashflowGraph
584	                  rows={runDetailRows}
585	                  {...cashflowGraphProps}
586	                />
587	              </>
588	            )
589	          ) : selectedRunIndex != null &&
590	            runDetailRows != null &&
591	            fundedRunDetailRows != null ? (
592	            <MonteCarloRunDetailTable
593	              rows={fundedRunDetailRows}
594	              pots={resolvedConfig.pots}
595	              simulationIndex={selectedRunIndex}
596	              simulationCount={result.simulationCount}
597	              startAge={config.currentAge}
598	              hasContributions={
599	                config.contributions.length > 0 ||
600	                config.pots.some(pot => pot.isSurplus)
601	              }
602	              incomeStreams={resolvedConfig.incomeStreams}
603	              withdrawalRule={resolvedConfig.withdrawalRule}
604	              cashflowGraph={
605	                <MonteCarloCashflowGraph
606	                  rows={runDetailRows}
607	                  {...cashflowGraphProps}
608	                  style={{ marginBottom: 15 }}
609	                />
610	              }
611	              onBack={() => setSelectedRun(null)}
612	            />
613	          ) : (
614	            <MonteCarloRunsTable
615	              rankedIndices={rankedRunIndices}
616	              endingBalances={result.endingBalances}
617	              depletionYearBySimulation={result.depletionYearBySimulation}
618	              totalWithdrawnBySimulation={result.totalWithdrawnBySimulation}
619	              startAge={config.currentAge}
620	              onSelectRun={simulationIndex =>
621	                setSelectedRun({ forConfig: config, index: simulationIndex })
622	              }
623	            />
624	          )}
625	        </View>
626	
627	        {/* Depletion histogram */}
628	        <View
629	          style={{
630	            backgroundColor: theme.tableBackground,
631	            padding: 20,
632	            flexShrink: 0,
633	          }}
634	        >
635	          <Text
636	            style={{
637	              ...styles.mediumText,
638	              fontWeight: 600,
639	              marginBottom: 5,
640	            }}
641	          >
642	            <Trans>When did the pot run out?</Trans>
643	          </Text>
644	          {hasFailures ? (
645	            <>
646	              <Text style={{ color: theme.pageText, marginBottom: 10 }}>
647	                {t(
648	                  'Only the {{failedCount}} of {{simulationCount}} scenarios that ran out of money are shown here - the other {{survivedCount}} kept a positive balance for the full horizon.',
649	                  {
650	                    failedCount,
651	                    simulationCount: result.simulationCount,
652	                    survivedCount: result.simulationCount - failedCount,
653	                  },
654	                )}
655	              </Text>
656	              <View style={{ height: 200, flexShrink: 0 }}>
657	                <MonteCarloHistogram
658	                  depletionHistogram={result.depletionHistogram}
659	                  startAge={config.currentAge}
660	                  medianDepletionYear={result.medianDepletionYear}
661	                  simulationCount={result.simulationCount}
662	                  style={{ height: 200 }}
663	                />
664	              </View>
665	              <View style={{ marginTop: 10, flexShrink: 0 }}>
666	                <Text style={{ color: theme.pageText }}>
667	                  {t(
668	                    'Worst case: money ran out at age {{worst}}. Among failures, the typical depletion age was {{median}}; the luckiest failure lasted until age {{best}}.',
669	                    {
670	                      worst:
671	                        config.currentAge +
672	                        (result.earliestDepletionYear ?? 1) -
673	                        1,
674	                      median:
675	                        config.currentAge +
676	                        (result.medianDepletionYear ?? 1) -
677	                        1,
678	                      best:
679	                        config.currentAge +
680	                        (result.latestDepletionYear ?? 1) -
681	                        1,
682	                    },
683	                  )}
684	                </Text>
685	              </View>
686	            </>
687	          ) : (
688	            <Paragraph>
689	              <Trans>
690	                The pot survived the full time horizon in every simulated
691	                scenario.
692	              </Trans>

721	              and the withdrawal covers the rest; anything left unspent is saved
722	              into the Surplus cash pot for later years when the plan keeps one,
723	              and otherwise leaves the plan; and then each pot grows or shrinks
724	              with that year&apos;s return. Pots with an access age stay
725	              invested but can&apos;t fund withdrawals until you reach it - if
726	              the accessible pots can&apos;t cover what a year&apos;s spending
727	              still needs, the plan counts as having run out, even if locked
728	              pots still hold money. The shaded bands show the range of outcomes

import { useMemo } from 'react';

import type { MonteCarloConfig } from '#components/reports/reports/monte-carlo/monteCarloSimulation';
import { useAccountBalances } from '#hooks/useAccountBalances';

/**
 * Resolves account-linked pots to their live balances: a linked pot takes
 * the account's current balance, falling back to its stored starting
 * balance until the live value arrives. Shared by the report page and the
 * dashboard card so both simulate the same portfolio.
 */
export function useResolvedMonteCarloConfig(
  config: MonteCarloConfig,
): MonteCarloConfig {
  const accountBalances = useAccountBalances(
    config.pots
      .map(pot => pot.accountId)
      .filter((id): id is string => id != null),
  );

  // Memoized by hand: this plain .ts file sits outside the React
  // Compiler's include (.tsx only), and the compiled consumers key their
  // auto-memoized simulation runs on this object's identity - a fresh
  // object every render would re-simulate on every unrelated re-render
  return useMemo(
    () => ({
      ...config,
      pots: config.pots.map(pot => {
        const balance =
          pot.accountId != null ? accountBalances[pot.accountId] : null;
        return balance != null
          ? { ...pot, startingBalance: Math.max(0, balance) }
          : pot;
      }),
    }),
    [config, accountBalances],
  );
}
import type { DashboardWidgetEntity } from '@actual-app/core/types/models';
import { useQuery } from '@tanstack/react-query';

import { dashboardQueries } from '#reports';

type UseDashboardWidgetProps<W extends DashboardWidgetEntity> = Partial<
  Pick<W, 'id' | 'type'>
>;

export function useDashboardWidget<W extends DashboardWidgetEntity>({
  id,
  type,
}: UseDashboardWidgetProps<W>) {
  return useQuery({
    ...dashboardQueries.listDashboardWidgets<W>(),
    select: widgets => widgets.find(w => w.id === id && w.type === type),
    enabled: !!id && !!type,
  });
}

type UpdateDashboardWidgetMutationPayload = {
  widget: EverythingButIdOptional<Omit<DashboardWidgetEntity, 'tombstone'>>;
};

export function useUpdateDashboardWidgetMutation() {
  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
  const dispatch = useDispatch();
  const { t } = useTranslation();

  return useMutation({
    mutationFn: async ({ widget }: UpdateDashboardWidgetMutationPayload) => {
      return await sendThrow('dashboard-update-widget', widget);
    },
    onSuccess: () => invalidateDashboardQueries(queryClient),

      dispatchErrorNotification(
        dispatch,
        t(

        ),
        error,
      );
    },
  });
}

  function onChangeLayer(direction: LayerDirection, layer: GraphLayers) {
    setLayerRange(prev => {
      const next =
        direction === 'from'

import type {
  RuleConditionEntity,
  SummaryContent,
  SummaryWidget,
  TimeFrame,
} from '@actual-app/core/types/models';

import {
  toComparableConditions,
  toComparableTimeFrame,
} from '#components/reports/widgetModified';

type SummaryMeta = NonNullable<SummaryWidget['meta']>;

export type SummaryWidgetSettings = Required<
  Pick<SummaryMeta, 'conditions' | 'conditionsOp' | 'timeFrame' | 'content'>
>;

const DEFAULT_SUMMARY_CONTENT: SummaryContent = {
  type: 'sum',
  divisorAllTimeDateRange: false,
  divisorConditions: [],
  divisorConditionsOp: 'and',
} as SummaryContent;

/** Reads the saved "Show as" settings, falling back to a plain sum. */
export function parseSummaryContent(content?: string): SummaryContent {
  if (!content) {
    return DEFAULT_SUMMARY_CONTENT;
  }
  try {
    return JSON.parse(content);
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Failed to parse widget meta content:', error);
    return DEFAULT_SUMMARY_CONTENT;
  }
}

/** The settings "Save widget" writes for a Summary widget. */
export function buildSummaryWidgetSettings({
  conditions,
  conditionsOp,
  start,
  end,
  mode,
  content,
}: {
  conditions: RuleConditionEntity[];
  conditionsOp: 'and' | 'or';
  start: string;
  end: string;
  mode: TimeFrame['mode'];
  content: SummaryContent;
}): SummaryWidgetSettings {
  return {
    conditions,
    conditionsOp,
    timeFrame: { start, end, mode },
    content: JSON.stringify(content),
  };
}

function toComparableSummaryContent(content?: string) {
  const parsed = parseSummaryContent(content);
  if (parsed.type !== 'percentage') {
    // The divisor settings only apply to percentages, and the report resets
    // the divisor filters when it opens with any other type.
    return { type: parsed.type ?? 'sum', fontSize: parsed.fontSize };
  }
  const divisor = toComparableConditions(
    parsed.divisorConditions,
    parsed.divisorConditionsOp,
  );
  return {
    type: parsed.type,
    fontSize: parsed.fontSize,
    divisorConditions: divisor.conditions,
    divisorConditionsOp: divisor.conditionsOp,
    divisorAllTimeDateRange: parsed.divisorAllTimeDateRange ?? false,
  };

            timeFrame: {
              start,

            },
            graphType,
            showBalance,
            balanceOnly: !showCategories,

          },
        },
      },
      {
        onSuccess: () => {
          dispatch(
            addNotification({
              notification: {
                type: 'message',
                message: t('Dashboard widget successfully saved.'),
              },
            }),
          );
        },
      },
    );
  }

  const onExportCsv = () => {
    if (!data) return;
    const csv = buildBudgetAnalysisCsv(
      data.intervalData,
      format.currency.decimalPlaces,
    );
    const reportName = (widget?.meta?.name || t('Budget Analysis'))
      .replace(/[^a-z0-9]/gi, '-')
      .toLowerCase();
    void window.Actual.saveFile(
      csv,
      `${reportName}-${start}-${end}.csv`,
      t('Export budget analysis'),
    );
  };

  if (!data || !allMonths) {
    return <LoadingIndicator />;
  }

  const latestInterval = data.intervalData[data.intervalData.length - 1];
  const endingBalance = latestInterval?.balance ?? 0;

  const title = widget?.meta?.name || t('Budget Analysis');

  const onSaveWidgetName = async (newName: string) => {
    if (!widget) {
      throw new Error('No widget that could be saved.');
    }

    const name = newName || t('Budget Analysis');
    updateDashboardWidgetMutation.mutate({
      widget: {
        id: widget.id,
        meta: {
          ...(widget.meta ?? {}),
          name,
        },
      },
    });
  };

  return (
    <Page
      header={
        isNarrowWidth ? (
          <MobilePageHeader
            title={title}
            leftContent={
              <MobileBackButton onPress={() => navigate('/reports')} />
            }
          />
        ) : (
          <PageHeader
            title={
              widget ? (
                <EditablePageHeaderTitle
                  title={title}
                  onSave={onSaveWidgetName}
                />
              ) : (
                title
              )
            }
          />
        )
      }
      padding={0}
    >
      <Header
        start={start}
        end={end}
        mode={mode}
        show1Month
        allMonths={allMonths}
        earliestTransaction={allMonths[allMonths.length - 1].name}
        latestTransaction={latestTransaction}

**Balance Forecast's page header is a fixed "Balance Forecast" title, not the widget name, and it has no rename. Where should "(modified)" go?**

Options:
- **Widget name, editable (Recommended)** - Show widget.meta.name with the inline rename, like the other reports. Adds a second save path (rename), which the acceptance criteria already anticipate.
- **Widget name, read-only** - Show the widget name but don't add renaming.
- **Keep fixed title** - Leave "Balance Forecast" and put the label next to it.

**Formula's rename handler currently saves ALL settings (formula, queries, font, color) along with the new name, unlike every other report. Should I keep that?**

Options:
- **Keep as-is (Recommended)** - No behavior change. Renaming also saves pending edits, so the label clears on rename — the label will just reflect that correctly.
- **Rename saves name only** - Match the other reports. Pending formula edits stay "(modified)" after a rename. Small behavior change outside the issue's stated scope.

**Monte Carlo saves linked pots' live account balances into the widget. Adopt the issue's proposal to ignore those computed balances in the comparison?**

Options:
- **Yes, ignore them (Recommended)** - For pots linked to an account, startingBalance is excluded; only user inputs count. Otherwise the label would appear whenever an account balance changes.
- **No, compare everything** - Any drift in a linked account's balance shows "(modified)".

**Beyond code + tests + release note, what else should I produce? (#125 also had a Stryker mutation report and an AI log.)** _(select multiple)_

Options:
- **Design decision write-up** - Draft the Design section (≥2 alternatives, rationale, consequences) as a Markdown file you can paste into the issue.
- **Branch + commit** - Create a feature branch and commit with the [AI] prefix. Tell me the issue number in the notes if you want it in the branch name.
- **Open a PR** - Push and open a PR with the [AI] title and the unfilled template.


**Answer:** Widget name, editable (Recommended), Keep as-is (Recommended), Yes, ignore them (Recommended), Design decision write-up, Branch + commit, Issue number 126". Read the answers carefully — they may request clarification, changes, or that you not proceed — and follow what they actually say.

          end: monthUtils.currentDay(),

        },
      },
    });

    setNewQueryName('');
    setIsAddingQuery(false);
  }

  function handleRemoveQuery(queryName: string) {
    const newQueries = { ...queries };
    delete newQueries[queryName];
    onQueriesChange(newQueries);

import * as monthUtils from '@actual-app/core/shared/months';
import type { FormulaWidget } from '@actual-app/core/types/models';

import { toComparableConditions } from '#components/reports/widgetModified';

type FormulaMeta = NonNullable<FormulaWidget['meta']>;
type FormulaQueries = NonNullable<FormulaMeta['queries']>;

export const DEFAULT_FORMULA = '=SUM(1, 2, 3)';
export const DEFAULT_STATIC_FONT_SIZE = 32;

export type FormulaWidgetSettings = Required<
  Pick<
    FormulaMeta,
    | 'formula'
    | 'queries'
    | 'fontSizeMode'
    | 'staticFontSize'
    | 'showTitle'
    | 'colorFormula'
  >
>;

/** The settings "Save widget" (and renaming) writes for a Formula widget. */
export function buildFormulaWidgetSettings(
  settings: FormulaWidgetSettings,
): FormulaWidgetSettings {
  const {
    formula,
    queries,
    fontSizeMode,
    staticFontSize,
    showTitle,
    colorFormula,
  } = settings;
  return {
    formula,
    queries,
    fontSizeMode,
    staticFontSize,
    showTitle,
    colorFormula,
  };
}

function toComparableQueries(queries: FormulaQueries | undefined) {
  // Mirrors the fallbacks the query editor uses when it opens a query, so a
  // query saved without some fields compares equal to what it shows.
  return Object.fromEntries(
    Object.entries(queries ?? {}).map(([name, query]) => [
      name,
      {
        ...toComparableConditions(query.conditions, query.conditionsOp),
        timeFrame: {
          start:
            query.timeFrame?.start ||
            monthUtils.dayFromDate(monthUtils.currentMonth()),
          end: query.timeFrame?.end || monthUtils.currentDay(),
          mode: query.timeFrame?.mode || 'sliding-window',
        },
      },
    ]),
  );
}

export function toComparableFormulaSettings(
  meta: Partial<FormulaMeta> | null | undefined,
) {
  // Same `||` fallbacks the report uses when it opens, so an empty formula
  // or a zero font size reads as the default on both sides.
  return {
    formula: meta?.formula || DEFAULT_FORMULA,
    queries: toComparableQueries(meta?.queries),
    fontSizeMode: meta?.fontSizeMode || 'dynamic',
    staticFontSize: meta?.staticFontSize || DEFAULT_STATIC_FONT_SIZE,
    showTitle: meta?.showTitle ?? true,
    colorFormula: meta?.colorFormula || '',
  };
}

export type SankeyGraphMode = 'budgeted' | 'spent';

export type LayerDirection = 'from' | 'to';
export type LayerRange = {
  from: GraphLayers;
  to: GraphLayers;
};

export function getAvailableLayers(mode: SankeyGraphMode): GraphLayers[] {
  return GRAPH_LAYER_ORDER.filter(layer => {
    if (mode === 'budgeted') {
      return layer !== GraphLayers.IncomePayee;
    }

    return layer !== GraphLayers.Budget;
  }) as GraphLayers[];
}

export function getDefaultLayerRange(mode: SankeyGraphMode): LayerRange {
  return {
    from:

        ? GraphLayers.IncomeCategory
        : GraphLayers.IncomePayee,
    to: GraphLayers.Category,
  };
}

import type {
  BudgetAnalysisWidget,
  RuleConditionEntity,
  TimeFrame,
} from '@actual-app/core/types/models';

import {
  toComparableConditions,
  toComparableTimeFrame,
} from '#components/reports/widgetModified';

type BudgetAnalysisMeta = NonNullable<BudgetAnalysisWidget['meta']>;
type BudgetAnalysisGraphType = NonNullable<BudgetAnalysisMeta['graphType']>;

export type BudgetAnalysisWidgetSettings = Required<
  Pick<
    BudgetAnalysisMeta,
    | 'conditions'
    | 'conditionsOp'
    | 'timeFrame'
    | 'graphType'
    | 'showBalance'
    | 'balanceOnly'
    | 'showHiddenCategories'
  >
>;

/** The settings "Save widget" writes for a Budget Analysis widget. */
export function buildBudgetAnalysisWidgetSettings({
  conditions,
  conditionsOp,
  start,
  end,
  mode,
  graphType,
  showBalance,
  showCategories,
  showHiddenCategories,
}: {
  conditions: RuleConditionEntity[];
  conditionsOp: 'and' | 'or';
  start: string;
  end: string;
  mode: TimeFrame['mode'];
  graphType: BudgetAnalysisGraphType;
  showBalance: boolean;
  showCategories: boolean;
  showHiddenCategories: boolean;
}): BudgetAnalysisWidgetSettings {
  return {
    conditions,
    conditionsOp,
    timeFrame: { start, end, mode },
    graphType,
    showBalance,
    balanceOnly: !showCategories,
    showHiddenCategories,
  };
}

export function toComparableBudgetAnalysisSettings(
  meta: Partial<BudgetAnalysisMeta> | null | undefined,
) {
  // Same fallbacks the report uses when it opens a widget.
  return {
    ...toComparableConditions(meta?.conditions, meta?.conditionsOp),
    timeFrame: toComparableTimeFrame(meta?.timeFrame),
    graphType: meta?.graphType || 'Bar',
    showBalance: meta?.showBalance ?? true,
    balanceOnly: meta?.balanceOnly ?? false,
    showHiddenCategories: meta?.showHiddenCategories ?? false,
  };
}

const WIDGET_ID = 'net-worth-widget-1';

function makeWidget(meta: NetWorthWidget['meta']): NetWorthWidget {
  return {
    id: WIDGET_ID,
    dashboard_page_id: 'page-1',
    type: 'net-worth-card',
    x: 0,
    y: 0,
    width: 4,
    height: 2,
    meta,
    tombstone: false,
  };
}

function renderNetWorth({
  path = `/reports/net-worth/${WIDGET_ID}`,
}: { path?: string } = {}) {
  let widgets = [
    makeWidget({ name: 'My net worth', timeFrame: SAVED_TIME_FRAME }),
  ];
  const updateWidget = vi.fn(async (update: unknown) => {
    const { id, meta } = update as Pick<NetWorthWidget, 'id' | 'meta'>;
    widgets = widgets.map(widget =>
      widget.id === id ? { ...widget, meta } : widget,
    );
  });
  initServer({
    query: () => Promise.resolve({ data: widgets, dependencies: [] }),
    'get-earliest-transaction': async () => ({ date: '2023-01-05' }),
    'get-latest-transaction': async () => ({ date: '2024-06-20' }),
    'dashboard-update-widget': updateWidget,
  });
  const queryClient = createTestQueryClient();
  const store = configureTestAppStore({ queryClient });

  render(
    <TestProviders queryClient={queryClient} store={store}>
      <MemoryRouter initialEntries={[path]}>
        <Routes>
          <Route path="/reports/net-worth" element={<NetWorth />} />
          <Route path="/reports/net-worth/:id" element={<NetWorth />} />
        </Routes>
      </MemoryRouter>
    </TestProviders>,
  );

  return { updateWidget };
}

// Minimal connection mock used by desktop-client component tests.
//
// This mirrors `@actual-app/core`'s test-only mock implementation so that
// `useSpreadsheet()` and other code paths can call `send()` and receive a
// promise with a stable shape.

type Listener = (args: unknown) => void;
type Handler = (args: unknown) => unknown | Promise<unknown>;

let listeners = new Map<string, Array<Listener>>();
let serverHandler:
  | null
  | ((msg: { name: string; args: unknown; catchErrors: boolean }) => unknown) =
  null;

export const initServer = (handlers: Record<string, Handler>) => {
  serverHandler = msg => {
    const { name, args, catchErrors } = msg;
    if (handlers[name]) {
      return Promise.resolve().then(() => {
        const promise = Promise.resolve(handlers[name](args));

        if (catchErrors) {
          return promise.then(
            data => ({ data }),
            error => ({ error }),
          );
        }

        return promise;
      });
    }
  };
};

export const clearServer = async () => {
  serverHandler = null;
  listeners = new Map();
};

export const serverPush = (name: string, args: unknown) => {
  void Promise.resolve().then(() => {
    const listens = listeners.get(name);
    if (listens) {
      listens.forEach(listener => {
        listener(args);
      });
    }
  });
};

export const send = async (
  name: string,
  args: unknown,
  { catchErrors = false } = {},
) => {
  if (serverHandler) {
    return serverHandler({ name, args, catchErrors });
  } else {
    throw new Error('`send` called with no mock server installed');

import * as monthUtils from '@actual-app/core/shared/months';
import type {
  BalanceForecastWidget,
  RuleConditionEntity,
  TimeFrame,
} from '@actual-app/core/types/models';
import type { ForecastSource } from '@actual-app/core/types/models/forecast';

import { toComparableConditions } from '#components/reports/widgetModified';

type BalanceForecastMeta = NonNullable<BalanceForecastWidget['meta']>;
type BalanceForecastGranularity = NonNullable<
  BalanceForecastMeta['granularity']
>;
type BudgetType = 'envelope' | 'tracking';

/**
 * The range a widget opens with. Unlike the other reports, Balance Forecast
 * shows the saved dates as they are, without re-resolving relative modes,
 * and still reads the `startDate`/`endDate` fields older widgets saved.
 */
export function getInitialBalanceForecastTimeFrame(
  meta: Partial<BalanceForecastMeta> | null | undefined,
): TimeFrame {
  const currentMonth = monthUtils.currentMonth();
  return {
    start: meta?.timeFrame?.start ?? meta?.startDate ?? currentMonth,
    end:
      meta?.timeFrame?.end ??
      meta?.endDate ??
      monthUtils.addMonths(currentMonth, 11),
    mode: meta?.timeFrame?.mode ?? 'static',
  };
}

/** The tracking-budget forecast is only offered on tracking budgets. */
export function getBalanceForecastSource(
  source: ForecastSource | undefined,
  budgetType: BudgetType,
): ForecastSource {
  return source === 'tracking-budget' && budgetType === 'tracking'
    ? 'tracking-budget'
    : 'schedules';
}

export type BalanceForecastWidgetSettings = Required<
  Pick<
    BalanceForecastMeta,
    | 'conditions'
    | 'conditionsOp'
    | 'startDate'
    | 'endDate'
    | 'granularity'
    | 'source'
    | 'timeFrame'
  >
>;

/** The settings "Save widget" writes for a Balance Forecast widget. */
export function buildBalanceForecastWidgetSettings({
  conditions,
  conditionsOp,
  start,
  end,
  mode,
  granularity,
  source,
}: {
  conditions: RuleConditionEntity[];
  conditionsOp: 'and' | 'or';
  start: string;
  end: string;
  mode: TimeFrame['mode'];
  granularity: BalanceForecastGranularity;
  source: ForecastSource;
}): BalanceForecastWidgetSettings {
  return {
    conditions,
    conditionsOp,
    // Kept for older versions that read these instead of `timeFrame`.
    startDate: start,
    endDate: end,
    // The tracking-budget forecast only has monthly data.
    granularity: source === 'tracking-budget' ? 'Monthly' : granularity,
    source,
    timeFrame: { start, end, mode },
  };
}

export function toComparableBalanceForecastSettings(
  meta: Partial<BalanceForecastMeta> | null | undefined,
  { budgetType }: { budgetType: BudgetType },
) {
  // Same fallbacks the report uses when it opens a widget. `startDate` and
  // `endDate` only mirror the time frame, so they are not compared apart.
  const source = getBalanceForecastSource(meta?.source, budgetType);
  return {
    ...toComparableConditions(meta?.conditions, meta?.conditionsOp),
    granularity:
      source === 'tracking-budget' ? 'Monthly' : (meta?.granularity ?? 'Monthly'),
    source,
    timeFrame: getInitialBalanceForecastTimeFrame(meta),
  };
}

import type { MonteCarloWidget } from '@actual-app/core/types/models';

import { monteCarloConfigFromMeta } from './monteCarloSimulation';
import type { MonteCarloConfig } from './monteCarloSimulation';

type MonteCarloMeta = NonNullable<MonteCarloWidget['meta']>;

/**
 * The Monte Carlo settings in comparable form: read the same way the report
 * reads a saved widget, so missing fields compare equal to their defaults.
 *
 * A pot linked to an account takes its starting balance from the account's
 * live balance, and saving stores that balance only as a fallback. It is a
 * computed value, not a user input, so it is left out: otherwise the label
 * would appear whenever the account balance moves.
 */
export function toComparableMonteCarloSettings(
  meta: Partial<MonteCarloMeta> | MonteCarloConfig | null | undefined,
) {
  const config = monteCarloConfigFromMeta(meta ?? undefined);
  return {
    ...config,
    pots: config.pots.map(pot => {
      if (pot.accountId == null) {
        return pot;
      }
      const { startingBalance: _computed, ...inputs } = pot;
      return inputs;
    }),
  };
}

export function getInitialLayerRange(

  layerTo: string | undefined,
): LayerRange {

import type {
  FormulaWidget,
  RuleConditionEntity,
} from '@actual-app/core/types/models';
import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';

import { isWidgetModified } from '#components/reports/widgetModified';

import {
  DEFAULT_FORMULA,
  DEFAULT_STATIC_FONT_SIZE,
  toComparableFormulaSettings,
} from './formulaWidgetSettings';
import type { FormulaWidgetSettings } from './formulaWidgetSettings';

type Meta = NonNullable<FormulaWidget['meta']>;

const CONDITION = {
  field: 'account',
  op: 'is',
  value: 'acct-1',
} as RuleConditionEntity;

const SAVED_META: Meta = {
  name: 'Groceries this month',
  formula: '=QUERY("groceries")',
  queries: {
    groceries: {
      conditions: [CONDITION],
      conditionsOp: 'or',
      timeFrame: { start: '2024-01-01', end: '2024-01-31', mode: 'static' },
    },
  },
  fontSizeMode: 'static',
  staticFontSize: 48,
  showTitle: false,
  colorFormula: '=IF(RESULT < 0, "red", "green")',
};

// What the report holds after opening SAVED_META.
const UNCHANGED: FormulaWidgetSettings = {
  formula: '=QUERY("groceries")',
  queries: {
    groceries: {
      conditions: [CONDITION],
      conditionsOp: 'or',
      timeFrame: { start: '2024-01-01', end: '2024-01-31', mode: 'static' },
    },
  },
  fontSizeMode: 'static',
  staticFontSize: 48,
  showTitle: false,
  colorFormula: '=IF(RESULT < 0, "red", "green")',
};

// One different value for every setting "Save widget" writes.
const CHANGES: FormulaWidgetSettings = {
  formula: '=QUERY("groceries") * 2',
  queries: {},
  fontSizeMode: 'dynamic',
  staticFontSize: 24,
  showTitle: true,
  colorFormula: '',
};

function isModified(saved: Partial<Meta> | null, current: Partial<Meta>) {
  return isWidgetModified({
    hasWidget: true,
    isReady: true,
    saved: toComparableFormulaSettings(saved),
    current: toComparableFormulaSettings(current),
  });
}

describe('Formula widget settings', () => {
  it('is not modified when the settings match the saved widget', () => {
    expect(isModified(SAVED_META, UNCHANGED)).toBe(false);
  });

  it.each(Object.keys(CHANGES) as Array<keyof FormulaWidgetSettings>)(
    'is modified when %s changes',
    key => {
      expect(isModified(SAVED_META, { ...UNCHANGED, [key]: CHANGES[key] })).toBe(
        true,
      );
    },
  );

  it('is modified while the formula text is being edited', () => {
    expect(
      isModified(SAVED_META, { ...UNCHANGED, formula: '=QUERY("groceries'),
    ).toBe(true);
  });

  it('is modified when a query changes', () => {
    expect(
      isModified(SAVED_META, {
        ...UNCHANGED,
        queries: {
          groceries: { ...UNCHANGED.queries.groceries, conditionsOp: 'and' },
        },
      }),
    ).toBe(true);
    expect(
      isModified(SAVED_META, {
        ...UNCHANGED,
        queries: {
          ...UNCHANGED.queries,
          rent: { conditions: [], conditionsOp: 'and' },
        },
      }),
    ).toBe(true);
  });

  it('is not modified after changing a setting back', () => {
    const edited = { ...UNCHANGED, formula: CHANGES.formula };
    expect(isModified(SAVED_META, edited)).toBe(true);
    expect(isModified(SAVED_META, { ...edited, formula: UNCHANGED.formula })).toBe(
      false,
    );
  });

  it('treats a widget without saved settings as the defaults the report opens with', () => {
    const defaults: FormulaWidgetSettings = {
      formula: DEFAULT_FORMULA,
      queries: {},
      fontSizeMode: 'dynamic',
      staticFontSize: DEFAULT_STATIC_FONT_SIZE,
      showTitle: true,
      colorFormula: '',
    };
    expect(isModified(null, defaults)).toBe(false);
    expect(isModified({ name: 'New formula' }, defaults)).toBe(false);
    // The report opens an empty formula or a zero font size as the default.
    expect(isModified({ formula: '', staticFontSize: 0 }, defaults)).toBe(
      false,
    );
  });

  it('fills in query fields the query editor would show', () => {
    const saved: Meta = {
      ...SAVED_META,
      queries: { groceries: { conditions: [CONDITION] } },
    };
    const current = {
      ...UNCHANGED,
      queries: { groceries: { conditions: [CONDITION], conditionsOp: 'and' } },
    } satisfies Partial<Meta>;
    expect(isModified(saved, current)).toBe(false);
  });

  it('follows the saved widget after renaming, which also saves the settings', () => {
    const current = { ...UNCHANGED, formula: CHANGES.formula };
    expect(isModified(SAVED_META, current)).toBe(true);

    // Renaming a Formula widget writes the name and the current settings.
    const afterRename: Meta = { ...SAVED_META, name: 'Renamed', ...current };
    expect(isModified(afterRename, current)).toBe(false);
  });

  it('ignores the widget name', () => {
    expect(isModified({ ...SAVED_META, name: 'Other name' }, UNCHANGED)).toBe(
      false,
    );
  });
});

// What the report holds after opening SAVED_META.

});

// One different value for every setting "Save widget" writes.

  mode: 'spent',

  categorySort: 'per-group',

  showTransfers: false,

  layerFrom: GraphLayers.IncomeCategory,
  layerTo: GraphLayers.Category,
  timeFrame: { start: '2024-01', end: '2024-07', mode: 'static' },
};

function isModified(saved: Partial<Meta> | null, current: Partial<Meta>) {
  return isWidgetModified({
    hasWidget: true,
    isReady: true,
    saved: toComparableSankeySettings(saved),
    current: toComparableSankeySettings(current),
  });

  it('is not modified when the settings match the saved widget', () => {
    expect(isModified(SAVED_META, UNCHANGED)).toBe(false);

    });
    expect(isModified(null, defaults)).toBe(false);
    expect(isModified({ name: 'Sankey' }, defaults)).toBe(false);
  });

  it('reads saved layers that do not fit the mode the way the report does', () => {
    // The payee layer is not available in budgeted mode.

      ...SAVED_META,
      layerFrom: GraphLayers.IncomePayee,
      layerTo: 'not-a-layer',
    };
    const opened = getInitialLayerRange('budgeted', 'income-payee', 'nope');
    expect(
      isModified(saved, {
        ...UNCHANGED,
        layerFrom: opened.from,
        layerTo: opened.to,
      }),
    ).toBe(false);
  });

  it('does not flag a sliding window just because time has passed', () => {
    const saved: Meta = {
      ...SAVED_META,
      timeFrame: { start: '2020-01', end: '2020-06', mode: 'sliding-window' },
    };
    const current = {
      ...UNCHANGED,
      timeFrame: {
        start: '2024-01',
        end: '2024-06',
        mode: 'sliding-window' as const,
      },
    };
    expect(isModified(saved, current)).toBe(false);
  });

  it('keeps the label after a rename that does not save the settings', () => {
    const current = { ...UNCHANGED, topNcategories: 20 };
    // Renaming writes only the name over the saved widget.
    const afterRename: Meta = { ...SAVED_META, name: 'Renamed' };
    expect(isModified(afterRename, current)).toBe(true);

    const afterSave: Meta = { ...afterRename, ...current };
    expect(isModified(afterSave, current)).toBe(false);
  });
});

import * as monthUtils from '@actual-app/core/shared/months';
import type {
  BalanceForecastWidget,
  RuleConditionEntity,
} from '@actual-app/core/types/models';
import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';

import { isWidgetModified } from '#components/reports/widgetModified';

import {
  buildBalanceForecastWidgetSettings,
  getBalanceForecastSource,
  getInitialBalanceForecastTimeFrame,
  toComparableBalanceForecastSettings,
} from './balanceForecastWidgetSettings';

type Meta = NonNullable<BalanceForecastWidget['meta']>;
type BudgetType = 'envelope' | 'tracking';

const CONDITION = {
  field: 'account',
  op: 'is',
  value: 'acct-1',
} as RuleConditionEntity;

const SAVED_META: Meta = {
  name: 'Checking forecast',
  accounts: ['acct-1'],
  conditions: [CONDITION],
  conditionsOp: 'or',
  startDate: '2025-01',
  endDate: '2025-12',
  granularity: 'Daily',
  source: 'schedules',
  timeFrame: { start: '2025-01', end: '2025-12', mode: 'static' },
};

// What the report holds after opening SAVED_META.
const UNCHANGED = buildBalanceForecastWidgetSettings({
  conditions: [CONDITION],
  conditionsOp: 'or',
  start: '2025-01',
  end: '2025-12',
  mode: 'static',
  granularity: 'Daily',
  source: 'schedules',
});

function isModified(
  saved: Partial<Meta> | null,
  current: Partial<Meta>,
  budgetType: BudgetType = 'tracking',
) {
  return isWidgetModified({
    hasWidget: true,
    isReady: true,
    saved: toComparableBalanceForecastSettings(saved, { budgetType }),
    current: toComparableBalanceForecastSettings(current, { budgetType }),
  });
}

describe('Balance Forecast widget settings', () => {
  it('is not modified when the settings match the saved widget', () => {
    expect(isModified(SAVED_META, UNCHANGED)).toBe(false);
  });

  it.each([
    ['conditions', { conditions: [] }],
    ['conditionsOp', { conditionsOp: 'and' }],
    ['granularity', { granularity: 'Monthly' }],
    ['source', { source: 'tracking-budget', granularity: 'Monthly' }],
    [
      'timeFrame',
      {
        startDate: '2025-02',
        timeFrame: { start: '2025-02', end: '2025-12', mode: 'static' },
      },
    ],
  ] as Array<[string, Partial<Meta>]>)('is modified when %s changes', (_, change) => {
    expect(isModified(SAVED_META, { ...UNCHANGED, ...change })).toBe(true);
  });

  it('writes the legacy date fields alongside the time frame', () => {
    expect(UNCHANGED).toMatchObject({
      startDate: '2025-01',
      endDate: '2025-12',
      timeFrame: { start: '2025-01', end: '2025-12', mode: 'static' },
    });
  });

  it('opens older widgets from their legacy date fields', () => {
    const legacy: Meta = { startDate: '2024-03', endDate: '2024-09' };
    expect(getInitialBalanceForecastTimeFrame(legacy)).toEqual({
      start: '2024-03',
      end: '2024-09',
      mode: 'static',
    });
    const opened = buildBalanceForecastWidgetSettings({
      conditions: [],
      conditionsOp: 'and',
      start: '2024-03',
      end: '2024-09',
      mode: 'static',
      granularity: 'Monthly',
      source: 'schedules',
    });
    expect(isModified(legacy, opened)).toBe(false);
  });

  it('treats a widget without saved settings as the defaults the report opens with', () => {
    const currentMonth = monthUtils.currentMonth();
    const defaults = buildBalanceForecastWidgetSettings({
      conditions: [],
      conditionsOp: 'and',
      start: currentMonth,
      end: monthUtils.addMonths(currentMonth, 11),
      mode: 'static',
      granularity: 'Monthly',
      source: 'schedules',
    });
    expect(isModified(null, defaults)).toBe(false);
    expect(isModified({ name: 'Balance Forecast' }, defaults)).toBe(false);
  });

  it('opens a tracking-budget widget on schedules when the budget is not a tracking budget', () => {
    expect(getBalanceForecastSource('tracking-budget', 'envelope')).toBe(
      'schedules',
    );
    const saved: Meta = { ...SAVED_META, source: 'tracking-budget' };
    expect(isModified(saved, UNCHANGED, 'envelope')).toBe(false);
    expect(isModified(saved, UNCHANGED, 'tracking')).toBe(true);
  });

  it('saves the tracking-budget forecast as monthly', () => {
    const current = buildBalanceForecastWidgetSettings({
      conditions: [CONDITION],
      conditionsOp: 'or',
      start: '2025-01',
      end: '2025-12',
      mode: 'static',
      granularity: 'Daily',
      source: 'tracking-budget',
    });
    expect(current.granularity).toBe('Monthly');
    expect(
      isModified({ ...SAVED_META, source: 'tracking-budget' }, current),
    ).toBe(false);
  });

  describe('when more than one place writes the widget', () => {
    it('keeps the label after renaming, which saves only the name', () => {
      const current = { ...UNCHANGED, granularity: 'Monthly' as const };
      expect(isModified(SAVED_META, current)).toBe(true);

      const afterRename: Meta = { ...SAVED_META, name: 'Renamed' };
      expect(isModified(afterRename, current)).toBe(true);
    });

    it('clears the label once "Save widget" writes the current settings', () => {
      const current = { ...UNCHANGED, granularity: 'Monthly' as const };
      const afterRename: Meta = { ...SAVED_META, name: 'Renamed' };
      const afterSave: Meta = { ...afterRename, ...current };
      expect(isModified(afterSave, current)).toBe(false);

      // A later rename keeps the newly saved settings, so it stays clear.
      const afterSecondRename: Meta = { ...afterSave, name: 'Renamed again' };
      expect(isModified(afterSecondRename, current)).toBe(false);
    });

    it('ignores the selected accounts, which the report never changes', () => {
      expect(isModified({ ...SAVED_META, accounts: [] }, UNCHANGED)).toBe(
        false,
      );
    });
  });
});
